subject: Headroom depletion & reserved throughput shortfall — VelociBank production impact
messages:
From: Mike Lewis <mike.lewis@velocibank.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@velocibank.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 18:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sudden production latency & errors - US-East (reserved capacity shortfall)

Kimberly —

We hit a serious regression this evening in US-East. Starting ~17:40 UTC we saw token-latency jump from ~180ms to ~600–900ms and an increase in 5xxs tied to model batching timeouts. Our dashboard shows queueing on the dedicated GPU pool and requests being throttled despite our reserved capacity. Attaching a screenshot and request logs for your team to triage.

This is impacting critical flows for our fraud detection pipeline — some job windows have missed SLAs. Can you confirm:
- Are you seeing saturated GPU pools or an API-level throttling event?
- ETA for meaningful remediation? We need an immediate mitigation and an exec contact.

Thanks,
Mike
Head of Platform — VelociBank
attachments: velocibank_dashboard_spike.png, request_logs_20270628.csv
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Mike Lewis <mike.lewis@velocibank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 18:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden production latency & errors - US-East (reserved capacity shortfall)

Hi Mike — thanks for the heads up and the artifacts. I'm escalating to Eng and CS now.

Quick notes while we triage:
- We see the same spike in our monitoring (queue depth and per-token latency).
- Your reserved pool shows high utilization and several model tasks are falling back to burst capacity which has been exhausted.

Can you confirm whether any configuration changed on your side (longer sequences, batching windows) in the 17:30–17:50 UTC window? Also, please share a sample request ID (one from the CSV) so we can trace it.

Ben/Vivek — looping you in. We need: immediate mitigation options (routing, temp capacity), an ETA for root cause, and a plan to avoid recurrence. I'll coordinate comms with VelociBank.

- Kimberly
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Mike Lewis <mike.lewis@velocibank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 18:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden production latency & errors - US-East (reserved capacity shortfall)

Thanks Kimberly — Ben here. Mike, I'm sorry you're seeing this. Per contract VB has a committed reserved cap for the east region; our telemetry indicates the reservation is fully consumed and requests spilled to shared burst, which then throttled.

Immediate asks from our side:
- Can you confirm whether there were any heavy offline jobs or sudden traffic spikes?
- If you want us to, we can provision short-term burst capacity on a priority lane for the next 12–24 hours while Eng diagnoses. That requires internal approval from infra; Vivek, can we get a priority pool for VelociBank?

I'll keep you posted on approvals and costs.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mike Lewis <mike.lewis@velocibank.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 19:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden production latency & errors - US-East (reserved capacity shortfall)

Mike/Kimberly/Ben — Vivek from Eng. Thanks for the data. Initial triage summary:
- Root signal: sudden increase in effective sequence lengths from a subset of clients at ~17:36 UTC; KV-cache hit rates dropped ~40% for that workload, causing per-request GPU time to spike and continuous-batching windows to expand.
- Result: scheduled reserved slots (pinned to specific GPUs) filled, spillover to shared burst exhausted, token service latency and transient 5xx.

Immediate remediation being executed (now):
1) Re-route new VelociBank traffic for the affected route to a hot lane with pre-warmed instances (reduces queueing) — ETA 25 minutes.
2) Temporarily increase reserved capacity for your account by 30% for 6 hours (non-persistent) — pending capacity approval; if approved we'll apply in ~40 minutes.
3) As a conservative fallback, we'll enable a soft model downgrade (quantized variant with similar quality) to reduce GPU time per request — 60 minute ETA to stage and test.

Attachments: mitigation_runbook_v1.pdf (runbook and rollback steps).

We're also collecting detailed request traces; Kimberly please share the sample request ID and we'll attach the trace output. Will update in the next 30 minutes with operational timelines.

- Vivek
VP Engineering — Redwood Inference
From: Mike Lewis <mike.lewis@velocibank.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden production latency & errors - US-East (reserved capacity shortfall)

Thanks — appreciate the rapid response. Sample request id from our log: rb-20270628-94217. Impact: multiple downstream jobs missed fraud-window SLAs between 17:45–18:10 UTC. We need a firm ETA on the priority lane and the temporary reserved increase. Also, what will this mean for our bill/credits? This is production-impacting for our largest retail customers — I'm escalating to our CTO and expect an executive contact at Redwood.

I'll await the trace and timeline.

Mike
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Mike Lewis <mike.lewis@velocibank.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Operational summary & next steps — VelociBank impact (RCA + credit)

Mike — Marissa here, head of Customer Success. Quick exec-level summary and actions we have taken: 

What happened (summary):
- A sudden workload pattern increased effective sequence length and reduced KV cache efficacy for your model route, saturating reserved slots in US-East and causing spillover to exhausted burst capacity.

What we did (immediate):
- Provisioned a hot priority lane for VelociBank (live at 12:18 PDT) to drain queue and stabilize latency.
- Applied a temporary +30% reserved increase for 6 hours (applied at 12:30 PDT).
- Staged a soft model downgrade (quantized variant) behind a canary for reduced GPU time — no customer-visible change observed during canary so far.

Next steps (24–72 hours):
- Full trace-based RCA (eng) by EOD tomorrow; root analysis and prevention plan including cache warmup and request shaping.
- Follow-up 1:1 with your platform leads + our CTO/Head of Product within 48 hours.
- Formal credit proposal: one-week service credit for the impacted window (draft attached).

Attachments: mitigation_runbook_v1.pdf, velocibank_dashboard_spike.png, request_logs_20270628.csv
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/velocibank
JIRA: JIRA-ENG-9817

We're treating this as high priority. Marcus, Vivek — please own the RCA and timeline. Ben/Kimberly I'll coordinate the exec call and the credit paperwork.

Thanks for bearing with us, and we'll be in touch with the RCA and post-mortem.

— Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
